name: core-latency-v5-live-v01
surface: root extension (loaded, Chromium) + Warden on 127.0.0.1:8756 (GLiNER, pairing) + planner per /health

frozenFlow.expected: one navigational click, then finish; no question

clock: extension stage clocks (utils/g11-stage-clock.js), exclusive spans summed over the steps of one run; total is the run wall time

gate.required: p95 end-to-end < 200 ms, n >= 100 after 10 warm-ups

scope: One synthetic page and one frozen flow on one container (4 CPU, no GPU), headless Chromium. Cloud planner latency includes the public internet. Not other pages, not real sites, not a toolbar gesture.
commit_note: The extension under test was copied from the tree at this commit when the run started; later commits (docs only) landed during the run.
compared_with: Benchmarks/results/core-latency-v5-live-v01.json (same Warden process, flow and harness; only the post-action settle differs)
concurrency_note: A background agent ran Chromium unit tests in this container during part of this run; the v01 run had no such load. CPU contention can only have slowed v02.
